主要内容: On February 6, 2013, the Small Business Administration (SBA) committed to reserve leverage in the form of debentures in an amount equal to $15.0 million to Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp.. FVC accepted the commitment on February 13, 2013 and paid a leverage fee of $150,000.00 to the SBA. The remaining leverage fee of $300,000.00 will be deducted pro rata as FVC draws from the commitment proceeds. FVC can draw from the commitment proceeds, in whole or in part, until September 30, 2017, the commitment’s expiration date. The commitment is attached as an exhibit to the Form 8-K filing and is incorporated by reference in its entirety. This financing arrangement is significant for both Medallion Financial Corp. and the broader financial services industry, as it provides FVC with access to capital for its operations and investments.
